name: movscript
description: MovScript project focus, domain source editing, planning, review, media query, and generation tools backed by the frontend MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Use MovScript projects, domain source, planning, review, media queries, and generation.
interface.longDescription: Installs MovScript project/domain/planning/review/generation guidance and connects to the MovScript frontend MCP server. The MCP bridge exposes system tools for focus, project creation, resources, external media, model discovery, image/video generation, and job polling, plus domain tools for object query/read/upsert/update, candidate management, inspect/review, interpret, and regeneration planning.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use MovScript's system_* tools for current focus, resource-library lookup, shot-library search, external media search, model discovery, and image/video generation. Use domain_* tools for MovScript project domain objects: query/read/upsert/update source entities, manage candidates, inspect/review changes, interpret, and read regeneration state. Treat generation input_resource_ids/reference_resource_ids as MovScript RawResource IDs only. For domain changes, prefer structured domain APIs; when an API does not cover the requested field or structure, call domain_get_model and edit source files under project.json, project_standards.json, settings/**, scripts/**, content_units/**, or productions/**. After each coherent semantic source change, run domain_inspect or domain_review, fix blocking issues, then run domain_interpret. Use domain_regeneration_plan after interpret for affected/stale downstream content units; affected means review, not automatic regeneration.
